entries.title: Grappler
entries.text:
You’ve developed the skills necessary to hold your own in close-quarters grappling. You gain the following benefits:

* You have advantage on attack rolls against a creature you are grappling.
* You can use your action to try to pin a creature grappled by you. To do so, make another grapple check. If you succeed, you and the creature are both <<term restrained>> until the grapple ends.
